created: 2026-10-16 13:45 KST, before any v2 GPU run
status: post-hoc exploration designed after seeing stage A/B2 and followup_v1 results; not confirmatory

unchanged.models: configs/models.json (revisions, tokenizer, chat template, served from same snapshots)

fixed_switch_policies.rule: model = B if task step >= s else A; applies to all attempts (retries) of a step; no router; once B stays B

main_run.order: per session, the 8 (policy, condition) combos shuffled with seed 31 (conditions interleaved in time)

baseline_check.reuse_rule: reuse P1/P2 for all 50 sessions iff (a) step outcomes identical in >= 38/40 runs and (b) median latency ratio new/old in [0.95, 1.05] for each condition; otherwise run BBBBB/AAAAA for all 50 sessions x 2 conditions in the same interleaved schedule and use only new baselines for latency comparisons

branch.source_path: P1 (always A): evalA for short, evalB_long_retain for long
branch.branch_points: start of task step 1 and step 3 (attempt 0)

paths.switchB: B from the branch step to the end

branch.restore: reset A,B,R prefix caches; replay to A the logged prompts A received before the branch turn (max_tokens=1); B stays empty; verify prompt hash and first-call hits (A expected = block-floored LCP, B expected = 0)
branch.order: all (point, path, rep) shuffled with seed 41
branch.excluded_cost: restore/prep time recorded separately (prep_s), not in path latency

lock: flock on ~/multiturn_routing_pilot/.gpu_runner.lock held by followup_v2/run_v2.sh for all GPU work

analysis.ci: session-level bootstrap (2000), stratified by scenario, descriptive only
analysis.best_in_set: per-session ex-post best = within these six policies only; no weighted quality-latency score
analysis.labels: difficulty/scenario labels used only in analysis
